units.zh: 列傳一百二十三
units.en: Biography 123
units.literal: Biographies 123

units.zh: 葉士寬陳夢說介錫周方浩金溶張維寅顧光旭
units.en: Ye Shikuan, Chen Mengshuo, Jie Xi, Zhou Fanghao, Jin Rong, Zhang Weiyin, and Gu Guangxu
units.literal: Ye Shikuan, Chen Mengshuo, Jie Xi, Zhou Fanghao, Jin Rong, Zhang Weiyin, Gu Guangxu

units.zh: 葉士寬，字映庭，江蘇吳縣人。
units.en: Ye Shikuan, whose courtesy name was Yingting, came from Wuxian County in Jiangsu.
units.literal: Ye Shikuan, styled Yingting, was a man of Wuxian County, Jiangsu.

units.zh: 康熙五十九年舉人，授山西定襄知縣。
units.en: He passed the provincial examination in the fifty-ninth year of the Kangxi reign and was appointed magistrate of Dingxiang in Shanxi.
units.literal: In the fifty-ninth year of Kangxi he became a provincial graduate and was appointed magistrate of Dingxiang in Shanxi.

units.zh: 求民隱，滌煩苛，不假胥吏，事辦而民不擾。
units.en: He sought out the people's grievances, swept away petty harassment, and handled affairs himself without leaning on clerks, so that business was done and the people left undisturbed.
units.literal: He sought the people's hidden grievances, washed away vexatious exactions, did not rely on clerks and runners, and matters were settled without disturbing the people.

units.zh: 雍正八年，擢沁州知州，署潞安知府。
units.en: In the eighth year of the Yongzheng reign he was promoted to department magistrate (zhizhou) of Qinzhou and served as acting prefect of Lu'an.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Yongzheng he was promoted to department magistrate of Qinzhou and acted as prefect of Lu'an.

units.zh: 除無名諸稅，复四門集以便商民。
units.en: He abolished assorted taxes levied without proper title and reopened the four-gate market to ease trade for merchants and townspeople.
units.literal: He abolished nameless miscellaneous taxes and restored the four-gate market to benefit merchants and commoners.

units.zh: 歷署平陽、太原，治行為山西最。
units.en: After serving in acting posts at Pingyang and Taiyuan, his administrative record was judged the finest in Shanxi.
units.literal: He successively acted in Pingyang and Taiyuan, and his record of governance ranked first in Shanxi.

units.zh: 十二年，舉卓異，擢浙江紹興知府。
units.en: In the twelfth year he was cited for outstanding service and promoted to prefect of Shaoxing in Zhejiang.
units.literal: In the twelfth year he was nominated as outstanding and promoted to prefect of Shaoxing in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 有惰民格殺士人，眾譁，將罷試，士寬方勘三江閘，馳歸，數言諭解之。
units.en: When a shiftless townsman killed a scholar, the crowd erupted in uproar and the examinations were nearly called off. Shikuan was inspecting the Sanjiang sluice at the time; he rode back at once and, with only a few words of persuasion, calmed the disturbance.
units.literal: A lazy commoner killed a scholar; the crowd clamored and the examinations were about to be canceled. Shikuan was surveying the Sanjiang sluice, galloped back, and with a few words persuaded them to desist.

units.zh: 風潮陷海塘，躬任堵築，三月而工完。
units.en: When wind and tide broke through the seawall, he took personal charge of the repairs, and the work was completed within three months.
units.literal: Wind and tide breached the seawall; he personally took charge of blocking and building, and the work was finished in three months.

units.zh: 乾隆初，調金華。
units.en: Early in the Qianlong reign he was transferred to Jinhua.
units.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong he was transferred to Jinhua.

units.zh: 東陽饑民求賑者以萬計，士寬曰：「按冊施賑，是賑冊非賑民也。」
units.en: In Dongyang, tens of thousands of famine victims came forward seeking relief. Shikuan said, "If we distribute aid strictly by the register, we are feeding the register, not feeding the people."
units.literal: In Dongyang starving people seeking relief numbered in the tens of thousands. Shikuan said: "Giving relief according to the register is relieving the register, not relieving the people."

units.zh: 乃召飢者前註名於冊，而斥二人，眾乃定。
units.en: He had the hungry come forward one by one to sign the register, then publicly rebuked two offenders, and the crowd at last quieted down.
units.literal: He then summoned the hungry forward to register their names in the book, and rebuked two persons; only then did the crowd settle.

units.zh: 二人者：一婦人，曾以訟至官，服華服，至是易敝衣乞賑，士寬識之，令褫其敝衣，內華服如故；
units.en: One was a woman who had once come before him in court dressed in fine clothes; she now wore rags to beg for relief. Shikuan recognized her and had the rags torn away, revealing the same fine garments underneath.
units.literal: Of the two: one was a woman who had once brought a lawsuit to court wearing fine clothes; now she changed into ragged garments to beg relief. Shikuan recognized her and ordered her shabby outer clothes stripped off—beneath, the fine garments were unchanged.

units.zh: 一男子，容甚澤，令飲癰莢汁，嘔出酒肉。
units.en: The other was a man with an uncommonly well-fed look; Shikuan made him drink a purgative decoction, and he vomited up wine and meat.
units.literal: The other was a man with a very lustrous complexion; he was made to drink juice of the carbuncle-pod plant and vomited up wine and meat.

units.zh: 眾驚服，冒賑者潛散去。
units.en: The crowd was awed into compliance, and those who had been feigning hunger quietly dispersed.
units.literal: The crowd was startled into submission, and those falsely claiming relief slipped away.

units.zh: 在金華三年，多善政，郡人為立生祠。
units.en: During his three years at Jinhua he carried out many beneficent measures, and the people of the prefecture built a shrine to him while he was still alive.
units.literal: During three years at Jinhua he enacted many good policies, and the people of the prefecture erected a living shrine to him.

units.zh: 擢杭嘉湖道，調金衢嚴道。
units.en: He was promoted to intendant of the Hang-Jia-Hu circuit and then transferred to the Jin-Qu-Yan circuit.
units.literal: He was promoted to the Hang-Jia-Hu circuit and transferred to the Jin-Qu-Yan circuit.

units.zh: 衢州地高，西安、龍遊諸縣，素築壩蓄水溉田？
units.en: Quzhou sits on elevated terrain; in Xi'an, Longyou, and neighboring counties the people had long relied on dams to store water for irrigation.
units.literal: Quzhou lies on high ground; in Xi'an, Longyou, and other counties they had always built dams to store water for irrigating fields.

units.zh: 木商入山者，私開壩，水日涸，士寬嚴禁之，民皆稱便。
units.en: Timber merchants going into the hills had been opening the dams on the sly, and the stored water dwindled day by day. Shikuan strictly forbade the practice, to the universal relief of the farming population.
units.literal: Timber merchants entering the mountains privately opened the dams, and the water daily dwindled. Shikuan strictly forbade this, and the people all praised the convenience.

units.zh: 八年，調寧紹台道。
units.en: In the eighth year he was transferred to the Ning-Shao-Tai circuit.
units.literal: In the eighth year he was transferred to the Ning-Shao-Tai circuit.

units.zh: 紹興大水，蕭山、諸暨民多挾眾詣縣求食，巡撫惡之，不欲賑。
units.en: When Shaoxing was struck by severe flooding, crowds from Xiaoshan and Zhuji marched on the county seats demanding food. The provincial governor took offense at the disorder and was unwilling to authorize relief.
units.literal: Shaoxing suffered great flood; in Xiaoshan and Zhuji many people gathered in crowds to go to the county seat seeking food. The governor detested this and did not wish to give relief.

units.zh: 士寬曰：「某來時，民飢幾欲死。
units.en: Shikuan said, "When I first came here, the people were starving to the point of death.
units.literal: Shikuan said: "When I arrived, the people were so hungry they were near death.

units.zh: 何忍坐視其悉填溝壑耶？」
units.en: How could I sit by and watch them all perish in the ditches?"
units.literal: How can I bear to sit and watch them all fill the ditches and ravines?"

units.zh: 繼以泣請，乃得上聞給賑。
units.en: He followed this with tearful entreaties, and only then was the case reported to the throne and famine relief approved.
units.literal: He then pleaded with tears, and only then was the matter reported upward and relief granted.

units.zh: 士寬以待飢而賑常不及，議濬紹興之鑑湖、寧波之廣德湖，會去官，未果。
units.en: Believing that waiting until famine struck before distributing aid was always too late, he proposed dredging Mirror Lake at Shaoxing and Guangde Lake at Ningbo, but he left office before the plan could be carried out.
units.literal: Shikuan, because waiting until famine to give relief often came too late, proposed dredging Mirror Lake at Shaoxing and Guangde Lake at Ningbo, but when he left office the plan was not realized.

units.zh: 著浙東水利書，冀後有行之者。
units.en: He wrote a treatise on water management in eastern Zhejiang, in the hope that a successor might one day act on it.
units.literal: He wrote a book on Zhedong water conservancy, hoping that later men would put it into practice.

units.zh: 父憂歸，遂不出。
units.en: After returning home to observe mourning for his father, he never took office again.
units.literal: Upon returning for his father's mourning, he never came forth again.

units.zh: 陳夢說，字曉岩，山西絳縣人。
units.en: Chen Mengshuo, whose courtesy name was Xiaoyan, came from Jiang County in Shanxi.
units.literal: Chen Mengshuo, styled Xiaoyan, was a man of Jiang County, Shanxi.

units.zh: 乾隆十三年進士，授刑部主事。
units.en: He received his jinshi degree in the thirteenth year of the Qianlong reign and was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Punishments.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year of Qianlong he became a metropolitan graduate and was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Punishments.

units.zh: 讞決，執法不阿上官；
units.en: When adjudicating cases he held to the law and would not defer to his superiors.
units.literal: In deciding cases he enforced the law without currying favor with superiors.

units.zh: 兼提牢，役不能為奸。
units.en: While also serving as prison superintendent, he kept the underlings from any misconduct.
units.literal: He also supervised the prison; the runners could not practice deceit.

units.zh: 累遷禮部郎中。
units.en: He rose through successive promotions to director in the Ministry of Rites.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to director in the Ministry of Rites.

units.zh: 出為浙江寧紹台道。
units.en: He left the capital to serve as intendant of the Ning-Shao-Tai circuit in Zhejiang.
units.literal: He went out to serve as intendant of the Ning-Shao-Tai circuit in Zhejiang.

units.zh: 台州素獷悍，寧海梅村民拒捕，提督將以兵往，旁村皆驚竄。
units.en: Taizhou had long been known for its fierce and unruly populace. When villagers at Mei in Ninghai resisted arrest, the provincial commander prepared to march troops against them, and neighboring hamlets scattered in panic.
units.literal: Taizhou had always been fierce and unruly; villagers of Mei in Ninghai resisted arrest, and the provincial military commander was about to send troops; neighboring villages all fled in alarm.

units.zh: 夢說輕騎臨縣，縣令已纟累系竄者數十人，盡釋之，曰：「吾來捕梅姓數人而已。」
units.en: Mengshuo rode to the county seat with only a light escort. The magistrate had already bound dozens of people from the surrounding villages, and Mengshuo released them all, saying, "I have come to arrest only a handful of men from the Mei clan."
units.literal: Mengshuo came lightly mounted to the county; the magistrate had already bound and detained several dozen who had fled, and he released them all, saying: "I have come to seize only a few men of the Mei surname."

units.zh: 獲誅拒捕者，而釋其少子一人。
units.en: He captured and executed those who had resisted arrest, but spared one younger son.
units.literal: He seized and executed those who resisted arrest, but released one younger son.

units.zh: 台人感之，謠其事為存孤記。
units.en: The people of Taizhou were deeply moved and spread a ballad about the affair, calling it the Tale of the Spared Orphan.
units.literal: The people of Taizhou were moved and balladed the affair as the Record of Preserving the Orphan.

units.zh: 修鄞縣錢湖徬。
units.en: He repaired the Qian Lake embankment in Yin County.
units.literal: He repaired the Qian Lake embankment in Yin County.

units.zh: 值上南巡，召見，素知其在刑部有能名，賜綺貂。
units.en: During the emperor's southern tour he was summoned to audience. The emperor, who had long known his reputation for competence at the Ministry of Punishments, rewarded him with a fur robe of fine sable.
units.literal: When the emperor made his southern tour he was summoned for audience; the emperor had long known his reputation for ability in the Ministry of Punishments and bestowed upon him fine sable.

units.zh: 尋以失察屬吏不職罣議，仍以道員用。
units.en: Shortly afterward he was censured for failing to detect misconduct by a subordinate, yet was retained in service at the circuit level.
units.literal: Soon afterward, for failure to detect dereliction by a subordinate official, he was censured but still employed as a circuit intendant.

units.zh: 授督糧道，卻餽金，漕政肅然。
units.en: Appointed grain-transport intendant, he refused bribes of gold and brought order to the grain-shipping administration.
units.literal: He was appointed grain-transport intendant, refused gifts of gold, and grain transport administration became orderly.

units.zh: 時訛言妖人翦發，蕭山捕僧了凡等四人，誣服，夢說平反之。
units.en: At the time a rumor spread that sorcerers were clipping people's hair. Xiaoshan arrested the monk Liaofan and three others, who confessed under coercion, and Mengshuo overturned the convictions.
units.literal: At the time a rumor spread that sorcerers were cutting people's hair; Xiaoshan arrested the monk Liaofan and three others, who confessed under false coercion, and Mengshuo reversed the verdict.

units.zh: 後或言事由浙見，解京訊治無驗，抵妄捕者罪，以夢說輕比，降秩。
units.en: Later it was reported that the affair had first appeared in Zhejiang. The case was sent to the capital for investigation, but no evidence was found. Those who had made wrongful arrests were punished, while Mengshuo was demoted for having treated the matter too leniently.
units.literal: Later someone said the affair had originated in Zhejiang; the case was sent to the capital for investigation and nothing was verified; those who had made false arrests were punished, but because Mengshuo had treated the offense too lightly, he was demoted in rank.

units.zh: 修餘杭南湖堤。
units.en: He repaired the South Lake embankment in Yuhang.
units.literal: He repaired the South Lake embankment in Yuhang.

units.zh: 署嘉興、嚴州、處州、湖州諸府，復原官。
units.en: After serving in acting posts at Jiaxing, Yanzhou, Chuzhou, and Huzhou, he was restored to his former rank.
units.literal: He acted in the prefectures of Jiaxing, Yanzhou, Chuzhou, and Huzhou, and was restored to his original rank.

units.zh: 夢說官浙十二年，所至有聲。
units.en: Mengshuo served in Zhejiang for twelve years and won renown wherever he was posted.
units.literal: Mengshuo held office in Zhejiang for twelve years and wherever he went left a reputation.

units.zh: 尋乞歸。
units.en: He soon petitioned to retire.
units.literal: Soon he requested to retire.

units.zh: 介錫週，字鼎卜，山西解州人。
units.en: Jie Xizhou, whose courtesy name was Dingbu, came from Jiezhou in Shanxi.
units.literal: Jie Xi, styled Dingbu, was a man of Jiezhou, Shanxi.

units.zh: 康熙六十年進士。
units.en: He received his jinshi degree in the sixtieth year of the Kangxi reign.
units.literal: Metropolitan graduate in the sixtieth year of Kangxi.

units.zh: 雍正初，授貴州畢節知縣。
units.en: Early in the Yongzheng reign he was appointed magistrate of Bijie in Guizhou.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yongzheng he was appointed magistrate of Bijie in Guizhou.

units.zh: 烏蒙土司叛，督運軍糧，遇逆苗，徒役欲棄糧走，錫週厲聲曰：「失糧法當死，犯苗亦死。
units.en: When the Wumeng native chieftain rebelled, Xi was charged with escorting military grain. They encountered hostile Miao, and the porters wanted to abandon the supplies and flee. Xi shouted, "To lose the grain is death under the law; to face the Miao is death as well.
units.literal: When the Wumeng native chieftain rebelled, he supervised transport of military grain; they met rebellious Miao; the laborers wished to abandon the grain and flee. Xi said in a stern voice: "To lose the grain is death by law; to encounter the Miao is also death.

units.zh: 死法毋寧死賊！」
units.en: Better die by the law than die at the hands of the enemy!"
units.literal: Better die by the law than die at the hands of bandits!"

units.zh: 策馬徑前，千夫擁糧而進，逆苗眙愕，鳥獸散。
units.en: He spurred his horse straight ahead, and a thousand men pressed forward with the grain. The hostile Miao stood stunned, then scattered like startled birds and beasts.
units.literal: He spurred his horse straight forward; a thousand men pressed forward with the grain; the rebellious Miao stared in astonishment and scattered like birds and beasts.

units.zh: 遷平遠知州。
units.en: He was transferred to serve as department magistrate of Pingyuan.
units.literal: He was transferred to be department magistrate of Pingyuan.

units.zh: 烏蒙倮夷复叛，川、滇苗、倮應之。
units.en: When the Wumeng Lolo rebelled again, Miao and Lolo across Sichuan and Yunnan rose in response.
units.literal: The Wumeng Lolo rebelled again, and the Miao and Lolo of Sichuan and Yunnan responded.

units.zh: 錫周先往撫大定苗，平遠得無患。
units.en: Xi went first to pacify the Miao of Dading, so that Pingyuan remained untroubled.
units.literal: Xi first went to pacify the Miao of Dading, and Pingyuan was spared trouble.

units.zh: 十三年，擢大定知府。
units.en: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to prefect of Dading.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year he was promoted to prefect of Dading.

units.zh: 古州苗亂，陷黃平、清平，驛路俱梗。
units.en: When the Miao of Guzhou rebelled, they overran Huangping and Qingping, and every courier route was cut.
units.literal: The Miao of Guzhou rebelled, seized Huangping and Qingping, and all courier routes were blocked.

units.zh: 塘兵妄報土酋安國賢通古州苗，剋期犯貴陽。
units.en: A courier soldier falsely reported that the native chieftain An Guoxian was conspiring with the Guzhou Miao and would attack Guiyang on a set date.
units.literal: A courier soldier falsely reported that the native chieftain An Guoxian was in league with the Guzhou Miao and would on a set day attack Guiyang.

units.zh: 大吏發川兵將至，國賢轄地九百里，眾惶駭。
units.en: The provincial authorities dispatched Sichuan troops that were already on the march. Guoxian's territory stretched nine hundred li, and the populace was thrown into panic.
units.literal: The high officials dispatched Sichuan troops that were about to arrive; Guoxian's jurisdiction extended nine hundred li, and the masses were terrified.

units.zh: 錫週甫蒞郡，立召國賢至，諭以禍福。
units.en: Xi had only just assumed the prefecture when he summoned Guoxian at once and lectured him on the consequences of loyalty and rebellion.
units.literal: Xi had just taken up the prefecture; he immediately summoned Guoxian and admonished him on fortune and calamity.

units.zh: 國賢伏地陳無交通古州狀，錫周曰：「汝率眾苗就撫，我以百口保汝不死，且止川兵。」
units.en: Guoxian prostrated himself and declared that he had had no dealings with Guzhou. Xi said, "Lead your Miao to accept pacification. I stake the lives of a hundred people on your safety, and I will halt the Sichuan troops as well."
units.literal: Guoxian prostrated himself and stated that there was no communication with Guzhou; Xi said: "You lead your Miao to submit to pacification; I guarantee with a hundred mouths that you will not die, and I will also halt the Sichuan troops."

units.zh: 時丹江亦被圍，乃請以川兵往援，丹江圍解而大定安堵。
units.en: Danjiang was also under siege at the time, so Xi requested that the Sichuan troops be sent to its relief. The siege of Danjiang was lifted and Dading was left in peace.
units.literal: At that time Danjiang was also besieged; he then requested that the Sichuan troops go to its relief; the siege of Danjiang was lifted and Dading was settled in peace.

units.zh: 南籠民王祖先素無籍。
units.en: Wang Zuxian of Nanlong had always been without household registration.
units.literal: Wang Zuxian of Nanlong had always been without proper registration.

units.zh: 以書符惑眾，播為逆詞。
units.en: He used written charms to deceive the people and spread seditious slogans.
units.literal: He used written charms to delude the masses and spread words of rebellion.

units.zh: 又粵西儂人王阿耳為寨長王文甲所執，竄入苗寨，誣文甲將糾合冊亨諸寨叛。
units.en: Meanwhile Wang A'er, a Zhuang man from western Guangdong, had been seized by the stockade chief Wang Wenjia. A'er fled into a Miao stockade and accused Wenjia of plotting to rally the stockades of Ceheng in rebellion.
units.literal: Moreover, Wang A'er, a Zhuang man of western Guangdong, was seized by the stockade chief Wang Wenjia; he fled into a Miao stockade and falsely accused Wenjia of plotting to rally the stockades of Ceheng in rebellion.

units.zh: 二獄同時起，株連千餘人，南籠獄不能容。
units.en: The two cases erupted at once, implicating more than a thousand people, and the Nanlong jail could not hold them all.
units.literal: The two cases arose at the same time, implicating more than a thousand persons; the Nanlong prison could not hold them.

units.zh: 滇、粵錯壤，寨苗多逃。
units.en: Because Yunnan and Guangdong share a tangled borderland, many stockade Miao fled across it.
units.literal: Yunnan and Guangdong adjoin in confused territory; many stockade Miao fled.

units.zh: 錫週奉檄往會鞫，蔽罪悉當，釋文甲及系累者，逃亡並歸，邊境以靖。
units.en: Xi was ordered to join in the joint investigation. He determined guilt and innocence justly throughout and released Wenjia and all those implicated with him. Fugitives returned from hiding, and the border was pacified.
units.literal: Xi received orders to go and jointly try the cases; the determinations of guilt were all appropriate; he released Wenjia and those implicated with him; the fugitives all returned, and the borderland was pacified.

units.zh: 攝貴東道，筦糧運。
units.en: While acting as intendant of Eastern Guizhou, he took charge of grain transport.
units.literal: He acted as intendant of Eastern Guizhou and managed grain transport.

units.zh: 時軍興，歲餽餉金二百四十餘萬兩、米八十餘萬石，調馬三千、夫五千，麕集鎮遠，漫無紀，夫縻廩食，馬累裡戶；
units.en: With campaigns underway, the province supplied more than 2.4 million taels of silver and over 800,000 shi of grain each year, while 3,000 horses and 5,000 laborers were requisitioned. They crowded into Zhenyuan without order: porters devoured the granaries, and horses burdened every village household.
units.literal: At the time military campaigns were underway; each year more than 2.4 million taels of silver and more than 800,000 shi of rice were supplied; 3,000 horses and 5,000 laborers were requisitioned; they crowded into Zhenyuan without regulation; laborers consumed grain stores, and horses burdened village households.

units.zh: 复於上游南籠諸府役民夫加運九站，下游銅仁諸府則增僱調二千人助役。
units.en: The upstream prefectures around Nanlong pressed civilians into nine extra relay stations, while downstream prefectures around Tongren hired an additional two thousand men to help.
units.literal: Moreover, in the upper reaches the prefectures of Nanlong and others pressed commoners to add transport over nine stations; in the lower reaches the prefectures of Tongren and others increased hired labor by two thousand men to assist.

units.zh: 錫週畫三策：以馬設台站，運凱里、丹江諸路；
units.en: Xi devised a three-part plan: establish horse relay stations for the routes through Kaili and Danjiang.
units.literal: Xi devised three plans: use horses to establish relay stations for transport on the routes of Kaili, Danjiang, and others.

units.zh: 夫按期日運台拱諸路，楚、粵米皆由水運；
units.en: Schedule porters by fixed dates along the Taigong routes, and move all grain from Huguang and Guangdong by water.
units.literal: Laborers were to transport on schedule on the Taigong routes and others; grain from Huguang and Guangdong was all to go by water transport.

units.zh: 分清江及古州、都江兩路，輓輸迅速，糧乃集。
units.en: He split transport between the Qingjiang route and the two routes through Guzhou and Dujiang. Cartage speeded up, and the grain finally accumulated.
units.literal: He divided the Qingjiang route and the two routes of Guzhou and Dujiang; cartage became rapid and grain was gathered.

units.zh: 上游之加運，下游之調夫，皆止之，省帑數十萬，民間亦減勞費之累。
units.en: He halted the extra upstream relays and the downstream labor levies alike, saving several hundred thousand taels from the treasury and easing the people's burden of labor and expense.
units.literal: The added transport in the upper reaches and the requisitioned laborers in the lower reaches were all halted, saving several hundred thousand in treasury funds; among the people the burden of labor and expense was also reduced.

units.zh: 補貴西道，調糧道。
units.en: He was appointed intendant of Western Guizhou and then transferred to grain-transport intendant.
units.literal: He was appointed to Western Guizhou circuit and transferred to grain transport intendant.

units.zh: 兵米折色，不收餘羨，兵民交頌之。
units.en: When military grain rations were commuted to cash payments, he refused to pocket the surplus, and soldiers and civilians alike praised him.
units.literal: When military rice was commuted to cash he did not collect surplus profit; soldiers and civilians alike praised him.

units.zh: 乾隆中，擢按察使。
units.en: During the Qianlong reign he was promoted to provincial surveillance commissioner.
units.literal: In the Qianlong period he was promoted to provincial surveillance commissioner.

units.zh: 錫週在黔中久，吏治、風土、民苗疾苦皆熟習，蒞之以誠，慎刑獄，興教化。
units.en: Having served long in Guizhou, Xi knew its administration, customs, and the hardships of both Han settlers and Miao by heart. He governed with sincerity, was careful in criminal matters, and promoted education and moral reform.
units.literal: Xi had long been in Guizhou and was thoroughly familiar with administration, local customs, and the sufferings of people and Miao; he governed them with sincerity, was cautious in criminal cases, and promoted education and transformation.

units.zh: 性素耿介，不諧於時，以老乞休。
units.en: Upright and uncompromising by nature, he never fit comfortably with the temper of the age and eventually petitioned to retire on grounds of age.
units.literal: By nature he had always been upright and unyielding, ill at ease with the times, and on account of age requested retirement.

units.zh: 上念其勞勚，召入覲，授太僕寺少卿。
units.en: The emperor, mindful of his long service, summoned him to court and appointed him vice minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
units.literal: The emperor, mindful of his toil, summoned him for audience and appointed him vice minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

units.zh: 閱三年，告歸。
units.en: Three years later he petitioned to return home.
units.literal: After three years he petitioned to return home.

units.zh: 方浩，字孟亭，安徽桐城人。
units.en: Fang Hao, whose courtesy name was Mengting, came from Tongcheng in Anhui.
units.literal: Fang Hao, styled Mengting, was a man of Tongcheng, Anhui.

units.zh: 雍正八年進士，授山西太原知縣。
units.en: He received his jinshi degree in the eighth year of the Yongzheng reign and was appointed magistrate of Taiyuan in Shanxi.
units.literal: Metropolitan graduate in the eighth year of Yongzheng; appointed magistrate of Taiyuan in Shanxi.

units.zh: 嘗知隰、平定二州。
units.en: He had previously served as magistrate of Xi and Pingding subprefectures.
units.literal: He had served as magistrate of the two subprefectures of Xi and Pingding.

units.zh: 隰民有茹素號為大乘教者，浩召至庭，啖以酒肉，人莫知其故。
units.en: In Xi there were vegetarians who called themselves adherents of the Mahayana sect. Hao summoned them to court and fed them meat and wine, to the puzzlement of all who watched.
units.literal: Among the people of Xi were those who ate only vegetables and called themselves the Mahayana sect; Hao summoned them to court and fed them wine and meat; no one knew his reason.

units.zh: 其後逮捕大乘教人連數郡，而隰民獨免。
units.en: Later, when Mahayana adherents were arrested across several prefectures, the people of Xi alone were spared.
units.literal: Afterward Mahayana adherents were arrested across several prefectures in succession, but the people of Xi alone were spared.

units.zh: 平定旱，奸民煽譁呶求糶，捕渠魁一人置之法，餘悉不問。
units.en: When Pingding suffered drought, agitators stirred up crowds demanding that grain be sold at reduced prices. Hao arrested a single ringleader and punished him by law, and let the rest go untouched.
units.literal: Pingding suffered drought; wicked commoners incited clamor demanding grain sales; he arrested one ringleader and punished him by law, and asked nothing of the rest.

units.zh: 遷潞安知府。
units.en: He was transferred to serve as prefect of Lu'an.
units.literal: He was transferred to be prefect of Lu'an.

units.zh: 會上西巡，取道澤、潞，吏平道，及道旁民田。
units.en: When the emperor made his western tour by way of Ze and Lu, officials leveled the road and the farmers' fields along it as well.
units.literal: When the emperor made his western tour, taking the route through Ze and Lu, officials leveled the road and also the civilian fields beside the road.

units.zh: 浩以鑾輿未出而民廢耕作，非上愛民之意，令耕如平時。
units.en: Hao argued that leveling fields before the imperial procession had even set out, forcing farmers to abandon their crops, was not what the emperor's love for the people intended. He ordered farming to continue as usual.
units.literal: Hao said that since the imperial carriage had not yet departed and the people were abandoning cultivation, this was not in accord with the emperor's intent to cherish the people; he ordered farming as in normal times.

units.zh: 民得收穫，而事亦治。
units.en: The farmers were able to bring in their harvest, and the preparations for the tour were completed without incident.
units.literal: The people were able to harvest, and affairs were also well ordered.

units.zh: 擢江西廣饒九南道按察副使，兼攝九江府事。
units.en: He was promoted to vice surveillance commissioner of the Guang-Rao-Jiu-Nan circuit in Jiangxi and concurrently handled the affairs of Jiujiang prefecture.
units.literal: He was promoted to vice surveillance commissioner of the Guang-Rao-Jiu-Nan circuit in Jiangxi and concurrently acted in the affairs of Jiujiang prefecture.

units.zh: 歲旱，米商未至，他郡縣乏食，大吏檄運倉糧往濟。
units.en: In a drought year, before grain merchants had arrived, neighboring prefectures and counties ran short of food. The provincial authorities ordered grain shipped from the local granaries to relieve them.
units.literal: The year was drought-stricken; grain merchants had not arrived; other prefectures and counties lacked food; the high officials issued orders to transport granary grain to relieve them.

units.zh: 浩以郡民咸待食，而移粟他往，恐生事，請獨輸九江倉，而屬縣停運，違大吏意。
units.en: Hao argued that with his own prefecture's people still waiting for food, shipping grain elsewhere might provoke unrest. He asked to contribute only from the Jiujiang granary and ordered the subordinate counties to halt shipments, defying the provincial authorities' wishes.
units.literal: Hao said that since all the people of the prefecture were waiting to eat, to move grain elsewhere might cause trouble; he requested to ship only from the Jiujiang granary and ordered the subordinate counties to halt transport, contrary to the high officials' intent.

units.zh: 未幾，安仁以阻運成大獄，大吏以此重浩。
units.en: Before long, Anren became embroiled in a major case for obstructing grain shipments, and the provincial authorities came to value Hao all the more for his foresight.
units.literal: Before long, Anren became a major case for obstructing transport; the high officials on this account held Hao in high regard.

units.zh: 旋調吉南贛道。
units.en: He was soon transferred to the Ji-Nan-Gan circuit.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to the Ji-Nan-Gan circuit.

units.zh: 奸民據險為亂，馳詣捕緝。
units.en: When ruffians seized defensible ground and rebelled, he rode at once to hunt them down.
units.literal: Wicked commoners seized strategic terrain and rose in disorder; he galloped thither to capture and apprehend them.

units.zh: 比大吏至，謀主已就擒，其敏捷如此。
units.en: Before the provincial authorities even arrived, the plot's leader was already in custody—such was his dispatch.
units.literal: By the time the high officials arrived, the ringleader had already been taken; such was his agility.

units.zh: 坐事罷，循例復職。
units.en: Dismissed for an offense, he was later reinstated under the usual regulations.
units.literal: He was dismissed for an offense and restored to office according to precedent.

units.zh: 方需次吏部，以疾卒。
units.en: While waiting his turn for appointment at the Board of Personnel, he died of illness.
units.literal: He was awaiting his turn at the Board of Personnel when he died of illness.

units.zh: 金溶，字廣蘊，順天大興人。
units.en: Jin Rong, whose courtesy name was Guangyun, came from Daxing in the Shuntian metropolitan district.
units.literal: Jin Rong, styled Guangyun, was a man of Daxing, Shuntian.

units.zh: 雍正八年進士，以刑部員外郎擢山東道監察御史。
units.en: In the eighth year of Yongzheng, after receiving his jinshi degree, he was promoted from vice director in the Ministry of Punishments to supervising censor of the Shandong circuit.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Yongzheng, a metropolitan graduate, he was promoted from vice director in the Ministry of Punishments to censor of the Shandong circuit.

units.zh: 高宗即位，詔求直言，溶上疏言安民五事：一曰開墾之地緩其昇科；
units.en: When the Qianlong Emperor took the throne, he called for candid counsel; Rong submitted a memorial on five measures to secure the people: first, delay elevating newly reclaimed land to full tax status;
units.literal: When Gaozong ascended the throne, an edict sought forthright counsel; Rong memorialized on five matters for pacifying the people: first, newly opened wasteland should have its promotion to taxable grade delayed;

units.zh: 二曰帶徵之項宜加豁免；
units.en: second, arrears still being collected should be further exempted;
units.literal: second, items carried forward for collection should receive added exemption;

units.zh: 三曰關稅正額之外免報盈餘；
units.en: third, stop reporting surpluses above the regular customs quota;
units.literal: third, beyond the fixed quota of customs duties, reporting of surplus should be waived;

units.zh: 四曰州縣殿最首重民事，不以辦差為能；
units.en: fourth, rank prefectures and counties chiefly on how they handle civil affairs, not on how well they run special commissions;
units.literal: fourth, in prefectural and county performance rankings civil affairs should come first, and competence should not be measured by handling special assignments;

units.zh: 五曰巡狩之地崇尚樸素，不以紛華取媚。
units.en: fifth, regions on the imperial tour should value plainness and not court favor through ostentation.
units.literal: fifth, places on the imperial tour should honor simplicity and not use splendor to win favor.

units.zh: 當是時，上命翰詹科道各進經史摺子，溶又上疏曰：「頭會箕斂以裕囊櫝者，匹夫之富也；
units.en: At that time the emperor ordered Hanlin, Imperial Academy, and censorate officials each to submit folded essays on the classics and histories; Rong memorialized again: "Heaping taxes head by head and bushel by bushel to swell one's purse is the wealth of a private man;
units.literal: At that time the emperor ordered members of the Hanlin Academy, Imperial Academy, and the censorate and surveillance circuits each to submit folded memorials on the classics and histories; Rong again memorialized, saying: "Taking in coin by the head and sweeping up grain by the bushel to fill one's purse is the wealth of a common man;

units.zh: 輕徭薄稅使四海咸寧者，天子之富也。
units.en: lightening corvée and taxes until the realm is tranquil—that is the wealth of the Son of Heaven.
units.literal: light corvée and thin taxes so that all within the four seas are at peace is the wealth of the Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 易卦：損下益上，上益矣而反名損；
units.en: In the Book of Changes: "Diminish the lower to benefit the upper"—the upper gains, yet the hexagram is named Diminishment;
units.literal: The Changes hexagrams: diminishing below to benefit above—the above is benefited yet it is called diminishment;

units.zh: 損上益下，上損矣而反名益。
units.en: The upper is diminished to benefit the lower; the upper loses, yet the hexagram is named Increase.
units.literal: diminishing above to benefit below—the above is diminished yet it is called increase.

units.zh: 蓋謂百姓足君孰與不足，百姓不足君孰與足，聖人制卦之意可深長思也。」
units.en: It means: when the people are secure, how could the ruler lack security; when the people are destitute, how could the ruler be secure—the sages' meaning in these hexagrams deserves long reflection."
units.literal: This is to say, if the common people are sufficient, how could the ruler not be sufficient; if the common people are insufficient, how could the ruler be sufficient—the intent of the sage in making the hexagrams is something to ponder deeply."

units.zh: 乾隆九年，湖廣總督孫嘉淦因徇巡撫許容奪職，命修順義城。
units.en: In the ninth year of the Qianlong reign, Sun Jiagao, governor-general of Huguang, was dismissed for favoring the provincial governor Xu Rong and was ordered to repair the walls of Shunyi.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Qianlong, Huguang governor-general Sun Jiagao was stripped of office for indulging Governor Xu Rong and was ordered to repair Shunyi city.

units.zh: 溶上疏論曰：「賞罰者，人主禦世之大權。
units.en: Rong submitted a memorial arguing: "Reward and punishment are the sovereign's supreme instruments for ruling the realm.
units.literal: Rong memorialized in argument, saying: "Rewards and punishments are the great authority by which the ruler governs the age.

units.zh: 臣工有罪，有罰鍰一例，因其素非廉吏，使天下曉然知所得者終不能為子孫計留也。
units.en: When an official errs, the precedent of a monetary fine applies because he was never an upright man, so the empire understands that ill-gotten gains cannot be kept for one's heirs.
units.literal: When officials have offenses, there is the precedent of monetary fine, because they are by nature not upright officials, so that all under Heaven clearly know that what they gained cannot in the end be set aside for their descendants.

units.zh: 孫嘉淦操守不苟，久在聖明洞鑑之中，而罰令出貲效力，恐天下督撫聞之，謂以嘉淦之操守，尚不免於議罰，或一不得當，而罰即相隨，​​勢必隳廉隅預為受罰之地。
units.en: Sun Jiagao's integrity is beyond reproach and has long been known to the throne; yet to fine him and require him to pay for labor—governors-general and governors everywhere may conclude that even Jiagao's record cannot escape censure, that any slip will bring a fine, and they will abandon integrity and budget for fines in advance.
units.literal: Sun Jiagao's conduct is not lax, long within the sage ruler's penetrating scrutiny, yet to fine him and order him to contribute funds for service—fearing that governor-generals and governors throughout the realm will hear of it and say that with Jiagao's conduct he still cannot escape censure and fine, or that if once he is not correct, fines will follow in succession, inevitably they will destroy integrity and prepare ground for accepting fines in advance.

units.zh: 是罰行而貪風起，不可不慎也。
units.en: If fines are imposed in this way, greed will spread; the Court must weigh this carefully.
units.literal: This is fines carried out and the wind of greed arising—one cannot but be cautious.

units.zh: 臣為嘉淦所取士，不敢避師生之嫌而隱默不言。」
units.en: I was Jiagao's chosen student and dare not stay silent for fear of the teacher-pupil tie."
units.literal: Your servant was a scholar selected by Jiagao and dares not avoid the suspicion of teacher and student to remain silent and not speak."

units.zh: 奏上，部議奪職。
units.en: When the memorial reached the throne, the ministry recommended his dismissal.
units.literal: The memorial was submitted; the ministry deliberated and stripped him of office.

units.zh: 未幾，特起為福建漳州知府。
units.en: Soon afterward he was specially recalled to serve as prefect of Zhangzhou in Fujian.
units.literal: Before long he was specially raised to prefect of Zhangzhou in Fujian.

units.zh: 漳俗強悍，胥吏千餘交結大吏家奴，勢力出長官上。
units.en: Zhangzhou folk were notoriously tough; over a thousand clerks had allied with the household slaves of senior officials and wielded more power than the prefect himself.
units.literal: Zhang custom is fierce and strong; more than a thousand clerks and runners formed ties with great officials' household slaves, their power exceeding the chief magistrate's.

units.zh: 有吳成者，設局誘博，擒治之，民稱快。
units.en: One Wu Cheng ran a gambling house; Rong arrested and punished him, to the people's delight.
units.literal: There was one Wu Cheng who set up a den to lure gambling; he was seized and punished, and the people expressed satisfaction.

units.zh: 華葑村距縣治二百里，康熙時嘗議設縣丞，以不便於胥吏，格不行。
units.en: Huafu Village lay two hundred li from the county seat; in the Kangxi reign officials had proposed an assistant magistrate there, but clerks blocked it as inconvenient to themselves.
units.literal: Huafu Village was two hundred li from the county seat; in the Kangxi era they once deliberated establishing an assistant magistrate, but because it was inconvenient for clerks and runners, it was blocked and not carried out.

units.zh: 溶復以請，布政使文不下府而直行縣，溶大怒，嚴訊縣胥，得其交通狀，乃詳請治罪而設官。
units.en: Rong petitioned again; the provincial treasurer routed documents straight to the county, bypassing the prefecture. Enraged, Rong interrogated the county clerks, uncovered their collusion, and secured orders to punish them and post an official at Huafu.
units.literal: Rong again requested it; the provincial treasurer's documents did not go down to the prefecture but went straight to the county; Rong was greatly angered, strictly interrogated the county clerks, obtained their collusion, and then in detail requested punishment and the establishment of an official.

units.zh: 其父老歎曰：「微金公，吾儕奔馳道路死矣！」
units.en: The village elders sighed, "Without Lord Jin, we would have worn ourselves out on the roads and died!"
units.literal: The village elders sighed and said: "But for Lord Jin, we would have rushed along the roads until we died!"

units.zh: 十三年春，閩省旱，斗米千錢，大府檄溶平糶。
units.en: In the spring of the thirteenth year drought struck Fujian; rice reached a thousand cash per dou; the provincial authorities ordered Rong to stabilize prices through government grain sales.
units.literal: In the spring of the thirteenth year Fujian province suffered drought; a dou of rice cost a thousand cash; the provincial government ordered Rong to sell grain at fair price.

units.zh: 溶勸富家出糶，給印紙令商人赴糴；
units.en: Rong persuaded wealthy households to sell grain and issued stamped permits for merchants to buy it;
units.literal: Rong urged wealthy households to sell grain, issued stamped papers allowing merchants to go purchase;

units.zh: 又請寬台灣米入內地之禁；
units.en: he also asked that restrictions on shipping Taiwan rice to the mainland be relaxed;
units.literal: he also requested easing the prohibition on Taiwan rice entering the interior;

units.zh: 民情帖然。
units.en: and popular sentiment calmed.
units.literal: Popular sentiment was settled.

units.zh: 其他脩文廟樂器，增書院膏火，皆次第舉行。
units.en: He also restored the Confucian temple's ritual instruments and increased academy stipends, completing each project in turn.
units.literal: Other matters—repairing the Confucian temple's musical instruments, increasing the academy's stipend for lamp oil—were all carried out in sequence.

units.zh: 遷台灣道。
units.en: He was promoted to intendant of the Taiwan circuit.
units.literal: He was transferred to the Taiwan circuit.

units.zh: 補陝西鹽驛道。
units.en: He was appointed intendant of the Shaanxi salt and courier circuit.
units.literal: He was appointed to the Shaanxi salt and courier circuit.

units.zh: 署布、按兩司事。
units.en: He served concurrently as acting provincial treasurer and surveillance commissioner.
units.literal: He acted in the affairs of both the provincial administration and surveillance commissions.

units.zh: 調浙江糧道，與巡撫陳學鵬牴牾，學鵬論溶迂緩不任事，原品休致。
units.en: Transferred to the Zhejiang grain circuit, he fell out with Governor Chen Xuepeng, who denounced him as slow and incompetent; Rong retired at his former rank.
units.literal: He was transferred to the Zhejiang grain circuit; he clashed with Governor Chen Xuepeng, who judged Rong as pedantic, slow, and unfit for office; he retired at his original rank.

units.zh: 卒，年七十三。
units.en: He died at the age of seventy-three.
units.literal: He died, aged seventy-three.

units.zh: 張維寅，字子畏，直隸南皮人。
units.en: Zhang Weiyin, whose courtesy name was Ziwei, came from Nanpi in Zhili.
units.literal: Zhang Weiyin, styled Ziwei, was a man of Nanpi, Zhili.

units.zh: 乾隆元年進士，授戶部江南司主事。
units.en: He received his jinshi degree in the first year of the Qianlong reign and was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue's Jiangnan bureau.
units.literal: A metropolitan graduate in the first year of Qianlong, he was appointed a secretary in the Jiangnan bureau of the Ministry of Revenue.

units.zh: 江南賦役甲天下，支銷留解，端緒毛櫛。
units.en: Jiangnan's tax and corvée burdens led the empire; disbursements, retentions, and remittances branched into countless threads.
units.literal: Jiangnan's taxes and corvée ranked first under Heaven; disbursements, retained funds, and forwarded payments had threads as numerous as hair on a comb.

units.zh: 維寅綜覈精密，猾吏不能欺。
units.en: Weiyin audited accounts with meticulous care, and crafty clerks could not fool him.
units.literal: Weiyin comprehensively checked with precision; crafty clerks could not deceive him.

units.zh: 遷吏部員外郎，考選監察御史，補掌貴州道。
units.en: Promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Personnel, he passed the censorial examination and was assigned to the Guizhou circuit.
units.literal: He was transferred to vice director in the Ministry of Personnel, selected through examination as a supervising censor, and appointed to manage the Guizhou circuit.

units.zh: 劾奏閩督誘人受賕而坐之罪，失政體，上是之，為通行飭戒。
units.en: He impeached the Fujian governor-general for entrapping men into taking bribes and then prosecuting them—an abuse of authority the emperor endorsed and circulated as a warning to all officials.
units.literal: He impeached and memorialized that the Fujian governor-general had induced people to accept bribes and then punished them—a breach of governmental propriety; the emperor approved it and issued it as a general admonition.

units.zh: 簡雲南迤東道，至，改補驛鹽。
units.en: Selected for the Yunnan Yidong circuit, he was reassigned on arrival to the courier and salt intendant post.
units.literal: Selected for the Yunnan Yidong circuit, upon arrival he was reassigned to courier and salt.

units.zh: 滇鹽無成法，維寅一一調之，使井官、煎戶、運夫、鋪商無偏累，滇人稱便。
units.en: Yunnan salt lacked settled regulations; Weiyin rebalanced every levy so well officials, refiners, carriers, and retailers were no longer unevenly burdened, and Yunnan folk praised the reform.
units.literal: Yunnan salt had no fixed law; Weiyin adjusted each item one by one, so that well officials, boiling-house households, transport laborers, and retail merchants had no partial burdens; the people of Yunnan praised the convenience.

units.zh: 歲節縮歸公銀七千兩。
units.en: Each year he saved seven thousand taels of silver for the public coffers.
units.literal: Each year he trimmed returned public silver by seven thousand taels.

units.zh: 以前官累，左遷知府。
units.en: Held liable for a predecessor's deficits, he was demoted to prefect.
units.literal: Because of a predecessor's entanglements, he was demoted to prefect.

units.zh: 於時東川官設牛馬站，通百色，銅往鹽返，謂可省費。
units.en: At that time Dongchuan officials established ox-and-horse relay stations linking to Baise, shipping copper out and salt back, claiming it would cut expenses.
units.literal: At that time the Dongchuan authorities set up ox and horse stations, connecting to Baise; copper went out and salt returned—they said costs could be saved.

units.zh: 既奏行，而路險阻，車摧折，牛馬多死，銅鹽耗失。
units.en: Once the plan was approved, the route proved treacherous: carts broke down, draft animals died in droves, and copper and salt were lost in transit.
units.literal: After it was memorialized and implemented, the road was perilous and obstructed; carts were broken, oxen and horses died in great numbers, and copper and salt were lost in waste.

units.zh: 維寅奉勘得實，以事不可已，請夷路用車，險僱夫役，貲出爐息，無溢費，且不擾民，從之，獲濟。
units.en: Weiyin investigated and confirmed the losses; since the route could not be abandoned, he proposed grading the road for carts, hiring porters on steep sections, funding the work from smelter profits without extra levies or troubling the people. The court agreed, and transport was restored.
units.literal: Weiyin on commission investigated and found it true; because the matter could not be stopped, he requested leveling the road for carts, hiring laborers in dangerous stretches, funds from furnace profits, no overflow expenses, and no disturbance to the people; it was followed and relief was obtained.

units.zh: 署鶴慶、永北，補臨安，調首郡，兼楚雄。
units.en: He served as acting prefect of Heqing and Yongbei, was appointed prefect of Lin'an, then transferred to the provincial capital while also overseeing Chuxiong.
units.literal: He acted in Heqing and Yongbei, was appointed to Lin'an, transferred to the chief prefecture, and concurrently held Chuxiong.

units.zh: 值地震為災，躬勘鶴慶、劍川、浪穹、麗江、昌門賑，活災氓每數万計。
units.en: When an earthquake struck, he personally inspected relief in Heqing, Jianchuan, Langqiong, Lijiang, and Changmen, saving tens of thousands of victims on each circuit.
units.literal: An earthquake occurred as disaster; he personally surveyed relief in Heqing, Jianchuan, Langqiong, Lijiang, and Changmen; each time he saved disaster victims by the tens of thousands.

units.zh: 遷督糧道，整頓銅廠，代償前官虧帑，待罪得脫。
units.en: Promoted to grain superintendent, he reorganized the copper works, repaid a predecessor's treasury shortfall from his own funds, and escaped punishment.
units.literal: He was transferred to grain superintendent circuit, put the copper works in order, paid compensation for a predecessor's treasury deficit, and awaiting punishment was released.

units.zh: 調浙江鹽道，未數月，調福建汀漳龍道。
units.en: Transferred to the Zhejiang salt circuit, he was moved again within months to the Fujian Ting-Zhang-Long circuit.
units.literal: He was transferred to the Zhejiang salt circuit; within a few months he was transferred to the Fujian Ting-Zhang-Long circuit.

units.zh: 閩俗獷悍，痛懲以法，擒巨猾，散夥黨，健訟鬥狠之風為息。
units.en: Fujian was notoriously lawless; he punished ruthlessly by law, seized major ringleaders, broke up gangs, and the culture of aggressive litigation and brawling subsided.
units.literal: Fujian custom is fierce and violent; he punished severely by law, seized great rascals, dispersed gangs, and the wind of vigorous litigation and fierce fighting ceased.

units.zh: 察冤決疑，人稱神明。
units.en: He exposed wrongful convictions and resolved doubtful cases; people hailed him as uncannily just.
units.literal: He examined wrongs and decided doubts; people called him divine in judgment.

units.zh: 舉卓異，入覲，上獎慰甚至。
units.en: Cited for outstanding service, he was received in audience and the emperor praised him with unusual warmth.
units.literal: Nominated as outstanding, he entered audience; the emperor praised and comforted him to an exceptional degree.

units.zh: 復之官，病卒。
units.en: He resumed his post but soon died of illness.
units.literal: He returned to office and died of illness.

units.zh: 顧光旭，字晴沙，江蘇無錫人。
units.en: Gu Guangxu, whose courtesy name was Qingsha, came from Wuxi in Jiangsu.
units.literal: Gu Guangxu, styled Qingsha, was a man of Wuxi, Jiangsu.

units.zh: 乾隆十八年進士，授戶部主事。
units.en: He received his jinshi degree in the eighteenth year of the Qianlong reign and was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
units.literal: A metropolitan graduate in the eighteenth year of Qianlong, he was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

units.zh: 晉員外郎，主鹽筴，兩淮解銀，輒掛欠百之十五。
units.en: Promoted to vice director, he oversaw salt affairs; Lianghuai remittances routinely showed a fifteen-percent shortfall.
units.literal: He was advanced to vice director, in charge of salt policy; when the Lianghuai circuit forwarded silver, it always showed a shortfall of fifteen per hundred.

units.zh: 光旭謂：「各省庫平皆部較頒，何獨兩淮歷久如是？
units.en: Guangxu said, "Every province's treasury scale-weights are set by the ministry—why has Lianghuai alone suffered this chronic shortfall?
units.literal: Guangxu said: "Every province's treasury scale-weights are issued after comparison by the ministry—why alone has Lianghuai been thus for so long?

units.zh: 是銀庫多索也。」
units.en: The silver vault is exacting too much."
units.literal: This is the silver treasury demanding too much."

units.zh: 白於長官除免之。
units.en: He reported to his superiors and had the excess levy abolished.
units.literal: He reported to his superiors and had it abolished.

units.zh: 擢御史。
units.en: He was promoted to supervising censor.
units.literal: He was promoted to censor.

units.zh: 二十四年，直隸、山東大水。
units.en: In the twenty-fourth year of the reign, Zhili and Shandong were struck by severe floods.
units.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Zhili and Shandong suffered great floods.

units.zh: 次年春，疏曰：「上年兩省災，截漕發帑加賑。
units.en: The following spring he memorialized: "Last year both provinces suffered disaster; the Court diverted grain tribute and opened the treasury for extra relief.
units.literal: The next spring he memorialized, saying: "Last year the two provinces suffered disaster; grain transport was diverted and treasury funds issued for added relief.

units.zh: 近見流民扶老攜幼入京，春來尤甚。
units.en: Yet I now see refugees entering the capital supporting the elderly and leading children, and since spring the influx has grown worse.
units.literal: Recently I have seen vagrant people supporting the old and leading the young into the capital; since spring it has been especially severe.

units.zh: 五城米廠飯廠人倍增，詢之，近京數百里，毀屋伐樹，賣男鬻女，老弱踣頓，不可勝計。
units.en: Crowds at the Five Cities grain and soup kitchens have doubled; inquiry shows that for hundreds of li around the capital people are tearing down houses, felling trees, selling sons and daughters, and the old and weak are collapsing in the roads beyond count.
units.literal: The Five Cities grain depots and soup kitchens have doubled their people; on inquiry, for several hundred li near the capital, houses are destroyed and trees felled, sons sold and daughters trafficked, old and weak collapsed in exhaustion beyond counting.

units.zh: 耳目所及如此，其外可知。
units.en: If conditions within sight are this dire, the suffering farther afield may be imagined.
units.literal: What ears and eyes reach is thus; what lies beyond can be known.

units.zh: 伏思救荒無奇策，惟督撫及有司親民之官實心實力方克有濟。
units.en: I submit that famine relief has no miracle cure: only when governors-general, governors, and magistrates who truly care for the people work with genuine devotion can relief succeed.
units.literal: I humbly consider that in famine relief there are no marvelous stratagems; only when governor-generals, governors, and local officials who are close to the people exert sincere heart and sincere strength can there be success.

units.zh: 各州縣未嘗不施賑，或委任佐貳，或假手胥吏，或設廠遠離村鎮，窮民奔走待食，或得或不得。
units.en: Every county distributes relief in name, yet some delegate to deputies, some leave it to clerks, some open kitchens far from villages; the poor rush about for food and may or may not be fed.
units.literal: Every prefecture and county has not failed to distribute relief, yet some delegate to deputies, some lend the matter to clerks, some set up depots far from villages and towns; the destitute run about waiting for food, sometimes obtaining it and sometimes not.

units.zh: 良法美意，一入俗吏之手，沾實惠者十不及五。
units.en: Once a good policy reaches a corrupt clerk, fewer than half those in need receive real help.
units.literal: Good laws and fine intentions, once they enter vulgar clerks' hands—those who receive real benefit are fewer than five in ten.

units.zh: 一二賢有司撫循周至，則他境流民聞風畢集，轉難措手。
units.en: Where one capable magistrate administers relief well, refugees from neighboring districts flock in, making his task harder still.
units.literal: When one or two worthy local officials comfort and follow through thoroughly, then vagrant people from other districts hear the wind and all gather, making it harder to handle.

units.zh: 此督撫不能真實愛民，下亦以應付塞責，一切皆屬具文。
units.en: This shows governors-general and governors do not truly care for the people; subordinates merely go through the motions, and every measure becomes paperwork.
units.literal: This is because governor-generals and governors cannot truly love the people; below them officials also treat it as perfunctory duty to fill obligations—everything becomes empty documents.

units.zh: 請敕下隨地撫綏，毋致流移失所。
units.en: I ask that the throne order local comforting so people are not driven from their homes.
units.literal: I request an imperial command sent down to comfort and pacify according to locality, and not allow drifting displacement and loss of home.

units.zh: 疏導積水，以工代賑，借給牛種，以資耕作。
units.en: Drain standing water, employ work-for-relief projects, and lend oxen and seed so fields can be planted.
units.literal: Drain accumulated water, use labor in place of relief grain, lend oxen and seed, to supply cultivation.

units.zh: 有流民有礦土，尉即重治督撫州縣之罪。
units.en: Wherever vagrants appear or land is left waste, the Court should immediately hold the responsible governor-general, governor, prefect, and magistrate to stern account.
units.literal: When there are vagrant people or wasteland, the authorities should immediately heavily punish the offenses of governors-general, governors, and prefectural and county officials.

units.zh: 來京饑民，已領廠賑。
units.en: Refugees who reached the capital have already received kitchen relief.
units.literal: Starving people who came to the capital have already received depot relief.

units.zh: 一年之計，在於東作。
units.en: The year's livelihood depends on the spring planting.
units.literal: The year's plan lies in the eastern plowing.

units.zh: 無力自回者給貲遣送，其本籍無倚賴者歸大興、宛平安輯，勿令棲流無著。
units.en: Those too poor to return home should receive travel funds; those with no kin in their native districts should be settled in Daxing and Wanping, not left homeless wanderers.
units.literal: Those unable to return on their own should be given funds and sent back; those with no support in their native place should be settled in Daxing and Wanping in peace, and not allowed to lodge drifting without fixed abode.

units.zh: 又每遇水旱，司、道、府親勘，先以供應煩州縣，所委佐貳，亦滋擾累，請嚴參重處。」
units.en: Moreover, whenever flood or drought strikes, intendants and prefects tour the scene in person, burdening counties with hosting their entourages; the deputies they send add further harassment. I ask that such officials be impeached and punished severely."
units.literal: Moreover, whenever flood or drought occurs, circuit, route, and prefectural officials personally survey—first they trouble prefectures and counties with provisions for their retinue; the deputies they delegate also increase harassment; I request severe impeachment and heavy punishment."

units.zh: 奏入，上善之。
units.en: The emperor received the memorial and commended it.
units.literal: The memorial entered; the emperor approved it.

units.zh: 命赴京畿察勘，疏消文安、大城積水。
units.en: He was ordered to inspect the capital region and drained the standing water at Wen'an and Dacheng.
units.literal: He was ordered to go to the capital region to inspect and survey, and drained accumulated water in Wen'an and Dacheng.

units.zh: 樂亭民擁閧縣門，撫定之，馳章請加賑。
units.en: When Leting townsfolk stormed the county yamen, he calmed them and urgently memorialized for additional relief.
units.literal: The people of Leting crowded and stormed the county gate; he pacified and settled them, galloped a memorial requesting added relief.

units.zh: 歷寶坻、灤州，盧龍，兩月竣事。
units.en: He worked through Baodi, Luanzhou, and Lulong and finished in two months.
units.literal: He passed through Baodi, Luanzhou, and Lulong; in two months the work was completed.

units.zh: 遷給事中。
units.en: He was promoted to supervising secretary.
units.literal: He was transferred to supervising secretary.

units.zh: 尋出為甘肅寧夏知府，調平涼。
units.en: He was soon appointed prefect of Ningxia in Gansu, then transferred to Pingliang.
units.literal: Soon he went out as prefect of Ningxia in Gansu and was transferred to Pingliang.

units.zh: 三十五年，大旱，請賑，初為上官所格。
units.en: In the thirty-fifth year a severe drought struck; his request for relief was initially blocked by superiors.
units.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, great drought; he requested relief but at first was blocked by superiors.

units.zh: 光旭親察災戶，亟發銀米，煮粥以賑，鄰縣飢者率就之。
units.en: Guangxu personally inspected disaster households, quickly issued silver and grain, and opened porridge kitchens; hungry people from neighboring counties flocked to him.
units.literal: Guangxu personally inspected disaster households, urgently issued silver and grain, boiled porridge for relief, and starving people from neighboring counties all came to him.

units.zh: 時災黎鬻妻子，道殣相望，光旭巡視山僻，賦詩曰：「輪蹄鳥道羊腸路，溝壑鳩形鵠面人。」
units.en: Victims were selling wives and children; corpses lined the roads. Touring remote mountain hamlets, Guangxu wrote: "Wheels clatter on trails narrow as a bird's flight, sheep's-gut steep; in gullies stand bodies like doves, faces like starving swans."
units.literal: At that time disaster victims sold wives and children; corpses lined the roads; Guangxu toured remote mountain districts and composed a poem, saying: "Wheel and hoof on a bird's-path, sheep's-gut road; gully and ravine with dove-shaped bodies and swan-faced people."

units.zh: 又曰：「產破妻孥賤，腸枯草木甘。」
units.en: And again: "Estates ruined, wives and children sold cheap; bellies empty, even wild plants taste sweet."
units.literal: He also said: "Estates broken, wives and children sold cheap; intestines dry, even plants taste sweet."

units.zh: 誦者感動。
units.en: All who heard the verses were moved.
units.literal: Those who recited it were moved.

units.zh: 自夏至次年三月始雨。
units.en: From midsummer until the third month of the following year no rain fell.
units.literal: From summer solstice until the third month of the next year rain finally began.

units.zh: 平涼、隆德、固原、靜寧各設粥廠二，饑民日增。
units.en: Pingliang, Longde, Guyuan, and Jingning each opened two porridge kitchens as the number of refugees grew daily.
units.literal: Pingliang, Longde, Guyuan, and Jingning each set up two porridge kitchens; starving people increased daily.

units.zh: 慮入夏疫作，給每口兩月糧，遣使歸耕。
units.en: Fearing summer epidemics, he issued two months' grain per person and sent people home to farm.
units.literal: Fearing that epidemics would arise as summer began, he gave each person two months' grain and sent them home to return to plowing.

units.zh: 時已擢涼莊道，總督文綬任以河東賑事，一切錢糧聽支取，知府以下聽調遣。
units.en: By then he had been promoted to intendant of Liangzhuang; Governor Wen Shou put him in charge of relief east of the river, with full authority over funds and grain and command over prefects and lower officials.
units.literal: By then he had been promoted to the Liangzhuang circuit; Governor Wen Shou entrusted him with Hedong relief affairs—all funds and grain were left to his disbursement, and prefects and below were left to his dispatch.

units.zh: 分八路比戶清勘，刊發三連票備考覈。
units.en: He divided the region into eight routes, surveyed household by household, and printed triplicate tickets for audit and verification.
units.literal: He divided into eight routes and household by household cleared and surveyed, printing and issuing triple tickets for reference and verification.

units.zh: 發姦摘伏，官吏惕息。
units.en: He ferreted out fraud and hidden abuses, and officials trembled into silence.
units.literal: He exposed wrongdoing and plucked out hidden evils; officials were wary and held their breath.

units.zh: 竟事無中飽，民獲更生。
units.en: The work was completed without embezzlement, and the people gained a new lease on life.
units.literal: When the affair ended there was no stuffing at the middle; the people obtained renewed life.

units.zh: 三十七年，金川用兵，文綬調四川總督，疏請光旭隨往，司三路餽餉，署按察使。
units.en: In the thirty-seventh year, war broke out in Jinchuan. When Wen Shou was transferred to governor-general of Sichuan, he memorialized asking Guangxu to accompany him to manage supplies along three routes, with Guangxu serving as acting provincial surveillance commissioner.
units.literal: In the thirty-seventh year, troops were used in Jinchuan; Wen Shou was transferred as governor-general of Sichuan, memorialized requesting Guangxu accompany him, overseeing three-route provisions, acting as surveillance commissioner.

units.zh: 蜀民失業無賴者，多習拳勇，嗜飲博，浸至劫殺，號為啯嚕子，至是益眾。
units.en: Many idle and unruly people in Sichuan took up boxing, gambling, and drinking, eventually turning to robbery and murder; they were called Gulu bandits, and their numbers swelled at this time.
units.literal: Shu people who lost work and were unruly mostly practiced boxing and brawling, addicted to drinking and gambling, gradually reaching robbery and killing, called Gulu ruffians, and by this time their numbers further increased.

units.zh: 嚴捕治之，改悔者發為運丁，頗收其用。
units.en: He cracked down on them severely; those who repented were enrolled as transport couriers and proved quite useful.
units.literal: He strictly captured and punished them; those who reformed were dispatched as transport laborers, greatly employing their use.

units.zh: 以秋審失出，罷職，留治糧餉。
units.en: He was removed from office after wrongly releasing a prisoner at the autumn assizes, but was kept on to continue managing grain supplies.
units.literal: Because of an erroneous release at autumn review, he was dismissed from office, but remained to manage grain provisions.

units.zh: 四十年，金川平，駐西路臥龍關經理凱旋兵十餘萬，帖然無擾。
units.en: In the fortieth year, after Jinchuan was pacified, he stationed himself at Wolong Pass on the western route to manage the return of more than a hundred thousand victorious troops, which passed through without incident.
units.literal: In the fortieth year, Jinchuan was pacified; he stationed himself at Wolong Pass on the western route to manage over a hundred thousand returning troops, quietly without disturbance.

units.zh: 事竣，乞病歸，年未五十。
units.en: When the work was done, he resigned on grounds of illness and went home, not yet fifty years old.
units.literal: When the affair was finished, he begged leave for illness and returned home, his age not yet fifty.

units.zh: 里居遇災，助賑一如在官時。
units.en: During his retirement, whenever disaster struck, he gave to relief efforts as generously as he had in office.
units.literal: While living at home he met with disaster and aided relief just as when in office.

units.zh: 主東林書院數十年，聚生徒講論道義，繼其鄉顧憲成、高攀龍之緒。
units.en: For decades he directed the Donglin Academy, gathering students to discuss ethics and moral principle in the tradition of his fellow townsmen Gu Xiancheng and Gao Panlong.
units.literal: He headed the Donglin Academy for decades, gathering students to discuss righteousness and the Way, succeeding the thread of his fellow townsmen Gu Xiancheng and Gao Panlong.

units.zh: 著響泉集。
units.en: He wrote the Xiangquan Collection.
units.literal: He authored the Xiangquan Collection.

units.zh: 沈善富，字既堂，江蘇高郵人。
units.en: Shen Shanfu, whose courtesy name was Jitang, came from Gaoyou in Jiangsu.
units.literal: Shen Shanfu, styled Jitang, was a man of Gaoyou, Jiangsu.

units.zh: 乾隆十九年進士，選庶吉士，授編修。
units.en: He passed the jinshi examination in the nineteenth year of the Qianlong reign, entered the Hanlin Academy as a bachelor, and was appointed a compiler.
units.literal: In the nineteenth year of Qianlong he passed the jinshi examination, was selected as Hanlin bachelor, and appointed compiler.

units.zh: 典江西、山西鄉試。
units.en: He served as chief examiner for the provincial examinations in Jiangxi and Shanxi.
units.literal: He presided over the provincial examinations of Jiangxi and Shanxi.

units.zh: 撰制誥，辦院事，纂修國史、續文獻通考，勤於其職。
units.en: He drafted imperial edicts, managed Hanlin affairs, and helped compile the national history and the Continuation of the Comprehensive Examination of Documents, performing his duties with tireless diligence.
units.literal: He drafted imperial edicts, managed academy affairs, compiled the national history and the Continuation of the Comprehensive Examination of Documents, and was diligent in his duties.

units.zh: 出為安徽太平知府，在官十有六年，尤盡心災賑。
units.en: He was appointed prefect of Taiping in Anhui, where he served sixteen years and devoted himself above all to disaster relief.
units.literal: He went out as prefect of Taiping in Anhui; in office for fully sixteen years, he especially devoted himself to disaster relief.

units.zh: 三十四年，大水，坐浴盆經行村落，得賑者五十萬口。
units.en: In the thirty-fourth year a great flood struck; traveling village to village by tub, he reached five hundred thousand people with relief.
units.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, great flood; sitting in a tub he passed through villages, and those who received relief numbered five hundred thousand mouths.

units.zh: 當塗官圩決，密勸富家出糶，禁轉掠，使各村自保。
units.en: When the official dyke at Dangtu burst, he quietly urged wealthy households to sell grain, banned looting, and helped each village organize its own defense.
units.literal: When the Dangtu official polder burst, he secretly urged wealthy families to sell grain, forbade plundering in turn, and enabled each village to protect itself.

units.zh: 有告某家不糶者，笞之，曰；
units.en: When someone reported that a household was refusing to sell grain, he had the accuser beaten and said:
units.literal: When someone reported that a certain family was not selling grain, he had him beaten with the bamboo and said:

units.zh: 「汝奉何明令使富家出粟耶？」
units.en: "By what official decree are you forcing wealthy families to sell their grain?"
units.literal: "By what explicit official order are you making wealthy families issue grain?"

units.zh: 民乃定。
units.en: The people then calmed down.
units.literal: The people then settled.

units.zh: 三十六年，泗州水，大吏檄善富往賑之，釐戶口之弊，民受其惠。
units.en: In the thirty-sixth year Sizhou was flooded; provincial authorities ordered Shen Shanfu to manage relief, corrected abuses in household registration, and the people benefited.
units.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, Sizhou flooded; the grand officials dispatched Shanfu by order to relieve it, rectified abuses in household registration, and the people received the benefit.

units.zh: 值大疫，設局施藥施瘞，絕葷祈禳。
units.en: During a major epidemic he opened relief stations to distribute medicine and bury the dead, abstained from meat, and prayed for deliverance.
units.literal: When a great epidemic occurred, he set up stations to dispense medicine and bury the dead, abstained from meat, and prayed for exorcism.

units.zh: 前後課屬縣種柳數百萬株，官路成陰。
units.en: Over the years he ordered subordinate counties to plant millions of willows until the official roads were lined with shade.
units.literal: Before and after he ordered subordinate counties to plant several million willow trees, and official roads became shaded.

units.zh: 埋暴十餘萬棺。
units.en: He arranged burial for more than a hundred thousand unburied corpses.
units.literal: He buried over a hundred thousand exposed corpses in coffins.

units.zh: 時傳妖人割發，搜捕令下，諸郡騷然，獨太平不妄捕一人。
units.en: When rumors spread that sorcerers were cutting people's hair, search orders threw every commandery into turmoil, but Taiping alone arrested no one unjustly.
units.literal: At the time it was rumored that sorcerers cut hair; when search-and-arrest orders went out, all commanderies were in uproar, but Taiping alone did not wrongly arrest a single person.

units.zh: 兄弟訟，察其詞出一手，杖主訟者。
units.en: In a lawsuit between brothers, he saw that both petitions had been written by the same hand and punished the instigator.
units.literal: When brothers sued one another, he saw that their words came from one hand and beat the one who initiated the lawsuit.

units.zh: 兄弟悔悟如初。
units.en: The brothers reconciled as before.
units.literal: The brothers repented and were as at first.

units.zh: 師弟互訐陰事，取案前文卷盈尺火之。
units.en: When a teacher and disciple accused each other of private wrongdoing, he burned a foot-thick stack of earlier case documents.
units.literal: When teacher and disciple mutually accused one another of private matters, he took the earlier case documents, a foot in thickness, and burned them.

units.zh: 曰：「爾詞必有稿，可上控郡守焚案，不汝靳。」
units.en: He said: "You surely kept drafts of your petitions. Appeal to the prefect if you want the case burned—I will not stop you."
units.literal: He said: "Your words surely have drafts; you may appeal upward to the prefect to burn the case—I will not be stingy with you."

units.zh: 兩造皆泣，訟乃息。
units.en: Both parties wept, and the lawsuit ended.
units.literal: Both parties wept, and the lawsuit then ceased.

units.zh: 貴池有爭地訟於部者，視舊牘，得成化二十一年閏四月官契，念愚民安知閏，檢明史七卿表，得是年閏四月文，據以定讞。
units.en: A land dispute from Guichi reached the ministry; examining old records, he found an official contract dated the intercalary fourth month of the twenty-first year of Chenghua. Knowing common people would not understand intercalary months, he checked the Ming History's table of the seven ministers, confirmed that year had an intercalary fourth month, and settled the case accordingly.
units.literal: At Guichi there was a land dispute sued to the ministry; viewing old documents, he obtained an official contract dated the intercalary fourth month of the twenty-first year of Chenghua; thinking that foolish commoners would not know intercalation, he examined the Ming History table of the seven ministers, obtained the document for that year's intercalary fourth month, and on that basis fixed the verdict.

units.zh: 四十六年，擢河東鹽運使。
units.en: In the forty-sixth year he was promoted to salt transport commissioner for Hedong.
units.literal: In the forty-sixth year he was promoted to salt transport commissioner of Hedong.

units.zh: 鹽池受淡水，歉產，商運蒙古鹽多勞費。
units.en: Fresh water entered the salt ponds and yields fell; merchants hauling Mongolian salt faced heavy costs and labor.
units.literal: The salt ponds received fresh water, yields were poor, and merchants transporting Mongolian salt incurred much labor and expense.

units.zh: 及鹽產復盛，弊多商困。
units.en: Once salt production recovered, abuses multiplied and merchants were hard pressed.
units.literal: When salt production again flourished, abuses were many and merchants were distressed.

units.zh: 善富曰：「鹽池自古為利，不當廢革。
units.en: Shen Shanfu said: "The salt ponds have been a source of profit since ancient times and should not be abandoned.
units.literal: Shanfu said: "The salt ponds have been profitable since antiquity and ought not be abolished and reformed.

units.zh: 若聽民自販，必致蒙鹽內侵。
units.en: If private trade is allowed, Mongolian salt will inevitably flood in.
units.literal: If one listens to the people selling on their own, it will surely cause Mongolian salt to invade inward.

units.zh: 商人之力，不患寡，患不均。
units.en: Among merchants the problem is not too few hands but unequal distribution.
units.literal: Among merchants' strength, one does not worry about scarcity but about unevenness.

units.zh: 其弊有三：奸商棄瘠據肥，一也；
units.en: There are three abuses: unscrupulous merchants abandon poor allotments and seize rich ones—first;
units.literal: Its abuses have three: unscrupulous merchants abandon lean and occupy fat—one;

units.zh: 費浮地遠，夥攫其利，二也；
units.en: distant routes with high costs let partners monopolize the profit—second;
units.literal: High costs and distant territories let partners grab the profit—two;

units.zh: 僉代之期，貧富倒置，三也。」
units.en: and rotation schedules invert rich and poor—third."
units.literal: The term of collective replacement inverts rich and poor—three."

units.zh: 乃總三省引地為三等均之。
units.en: He then consolidated the salt allocation territories of three provinces into three equal grades.
units.literal: He then totaled the three provinces' quota lands into three equal grades and equalized them.

units.zh: 復以道路遠近順配為五十六路，鬮分簽掣之，於是賂絕弊清。
units.en: He then assigned fifty-six routes by distance, distributing them by lottery, and bribery ceased and abuses were cleared.
units.literal: Further, according to the nearness and distance of roads he arranged them into fifty-six routes, divided by lot and drawn by ballot, and thus bribes ceased and abuses were cleared.

units.zh: 後乾隆末廢商運，蒙鹽果內侵，至嘉慶十一年，仍復舊制，皆如所預計。
units.en: Later, at the end of the Qianlong reign, merchant transport was abolished and Mongolian salt did flood in as he had predicted; by the eleventh year of Jiaqing the old system was restored, exactly as he had foreseen.
units.literal: Later, at the end of Qianlong, merchant transport was abolished, Mongolian salt indeed invaded inward, and by the eleventh year of Jiaqing the old system was restored—all as he had foreseen.

units.zh: 所至興學愛士，人文蔚起。
units.en: Everywhere he served he promoted learning and nurtured scholars, and local culture flourished.
units.literal: Wherever he arrived he promoted learning and cherished scholars, and local culture flourished and rose.

units.zh: 以母老乞終養，居鄉多善舉。
units.en: When his mother grew old he requested leave to care for her, and in retirement he undertook many charitable works.
units.literal: Because his mother was old he begged leave for lifelong nurture, and while living in his home district he performed many good deeds.

units.zh: 著味鐙齋詩文集。
units.en: He wrote the Collected Poetry and Prose of the Wei Deng Studio.
units.literal: He authored the Wei Deng Studio collected poetry and prose.

units.zh: 方昂，字坳堂，山東歷城人。
units.en: Fang Ang, whose courtesy name was Aotang, came from Licheng in Shandong.
units.literal: Fang Ang, styled Aotang, was a man of Licheng, Shandong.

units.zh: 乾隆三十六年進士，授刑部主事，累晉郎中。
units.en: He passed the jinshi examination in the thirty-sixth year of the Qianlong reign, entered the Ministry of Punishments as a principal clerk, and rose to department director.
units.literal: A jinshi of the thirty-sixth year of Qianlong, he was appointed a principal clerk in the Ministry of Punishments and was repeatedly promoted to department director.

units.zh: 會秋讞更新例，凡金刃殺人，概為情實。
units.en: When autumn case review adopted new regulations, every murder committed with a blade was classified as a capital offense.
units.literal: It happened that autumn case review updated the regulations: all killings with metal blades were generally treated as cases warranting execution.

units.zh: 昂分別其輕重，固爭不得，後高宗特旨改正。
units.en: Fang Ang distinguished between serious and minor cases and argued against the blanket rule without success; later the Qianlong Emperor issued a special edict correcting the policy.
units.literal: Ang distinguished their light and heavy, firmly argued but could not prevail; later Gaozong by special edict corrected it.

units.zh: 坐是為同僚所忌，淹滯十年。
units.en: For this his colleagues resented him, and he languished in the same post for ten years.
units.literal: Because of this he was envied by colleagues and stagnated for ten years.

units.zh: 又數上書與長官爭，長官慍之，卒重其人。
units.en: He repeatedly submitted memorials disputing his superiors, who grew angry yet ultimately came to respect his integrity.
units.literal: He also repeatedly submitted memorials disputing with superiors; the superiors were angry with him, but in the end valued the man.

units.zh: 以薦出為江西饒州知府。
units.en: Recommended for promotion, he was appointed prefect of Raozhou in Jiangxi.
units.literal: On recommendation he went out as prefect of Raozhou in Jiangxi.

units.zh: 安南阮光平入覲，驛傳所經，多飾供帳。
units.en: When Nguyen Quang Binh of Annam came to pay tribute, post stations along his route were lavishly decorated.
units.literal: Nguyen Quang Binh of Annam came to audience; along the post stations he passed, many decorated provisions and tents.

units.zh: 昂曰：「國家以威德服四夷，非誇以靡麗。」
units.en: Fang Ang said: "The empire wins over foreign peoples through power and virtue, not by dazzling them with extravagance."
units.literal: Ang said: "The state by power and virtue subdues the four barbarians, not by boasting with extravagant splendor."

units.zh: 戒所屬勿與。
units.en: He ordered his subordinates not to contribute.
units.literal: He warned his subordinates not to participate.

units.zh: 擢江蘇蘇松道，已受代將行，營弁緝鹽，波及良善，眾洶洶不平。
units.en: Promoted to intendant of Suzhou and Songjiang, he was finishing his handover when military officers conducting a salt crackdown ensnared innocent people, and public outrage boiled over.
units.literal: He was promoted to the Suzhou-Songjiang circuit; already having received his replacement and about to depart, camp officers pursued salt and the dragnet touched the innocent; the crowd was in noisy uproar and discontent.

units.zh: 營弁以民變告，且徵兵，昂曰：「新守與民未習，民勿信。」
units.en: The officers reported a popular uprising and requested troops; Fang Ang said: "The incoming prefect is unknown to the people and will not be trusted."
